timeline.t: MBA and a career in multinational companies
timeline.d: Sadhak Ji studied management and spent his early working years in multinational companies, in roles that ran on targets, reports and deadlines.
timeline.note: The discipline of those years still shapes how he works: clear reasoning, careful records and plain language.

timeline.d: A long personal crisis led him to the sadhana he had watched his elders keep. The results he saw in his own life were steady enough to make him ask why.
timeline.note: He began to treat the practice the way he had treated work: as something to test, record and understand.

timeline.t: Years of sadhana under enlightened mentors
timeline.d: He left the corporate path and gave himself to sadhana in the Shakta tradition, learning mantra, vidhi and niyam directly from his mentors, one anushthan at a time.
timeline.note: Maa Kali’s sadhana became the centre of his practice and later gave the platform its name.

timeline.d: Alongside his own practice he began studying paranormal cases brought to his mentors, keeping written notes and reading each one against the shastras.
timeline.note: This work is behind his insistence that every case is analysed before anything is suggested.

timeline.d: He founded Maa Kali Astuti to offer consultations, sadhana courses and energized products in one honest place, without fear-selling or false promises.
timeline.note: Every product is energized in Mahapuja before dispatch, and every consultation is read personally.

timeline.d: Today he guides seekers by call, video and WhatsApp, teaches six sadhana courses, performs anushthans and shares weekly discourses on YouTube.
timeline.note: Guidance continues until a seeker’s doubts are resolved. That promise has not changed.

pillars: Every answer comes with its reason
A prediction is explained through the chart: the dasha, the house and the graha behind it. You should be able to follow the reasoning, not just the result.
Mantra, daan and niyam come first. A rudraksha, stone or kavach is suggested only when it clearly helps, and buying one is never a condition of guidance.
No threats of doshas, no urgent rituals. When a ritual is not the right path, you are told so plainly and shown what may help instead.
quote: Welcome to a space where ancient spiritual wisdom meets modern clarity.
